image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a group of young children participating in a maypole dance. The foreground features the backs and sides of several children holding colorful ribbons (streamers). A blonde child in a brown hoodie is central, holding a pink ribbon. To her left, a girl with dark hair holds a green ribbon. In the background, other children and adults are visible, some wearing festive hats. The top of the maypole is not visible; only the hanging streamers and the participants are in frame.
